prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (industry, goals, budget, channels and timeline). I can help you find the best fit. To start, here’s a quick framework and next step options.

How to judge the “best” agency for you
- Match to your goals: look for agencies with proven work in the services you need (SEO, paid media, social, brand, creative, B2B demand gen, healthcare/biotech, etc.).  
- Relevant industry experience: an agency that understands your vertical will move faster and produce better results.  
- Measurable results & case studies: ask for metrics (CTR, conversion rate, cost-per-lead, revenue uplift) from comparable clients.  
- Size & culture fit: larger agencies bring breadth and resources; boutiques can be more nimble and creative.  
- Team you’ll work with: confirm who will handle strategy, execution, reporting and whether those people will be your regular contacts.  
- Pricing & contract flexibility: hourly vs retainer vs performance-based; trial project options.  
- References & transparency: ask for references and for a clear reporting cadence and KPIs.

Questions I can use to shortlist agencies for you
- What city/area in Maryland do you prefer (Baltimore, DC suburbs, Annapolis, western MD)?  
- What industry are you in? (e.g., B2B SaaS, healthcare, real estate, retail, nonprofits)  
- What services do you need? (brand/creative, website, SEO, PPC, social, PR, content, account-based marketing)  
- Monthly budget or annual marketing spend?  
- Timeline / major milestones?

If you want, I can:
- Give a short list of 5–8 Maryland agencies matched to your answers (with strengths, pricing ballpark, and a suggested first question to ask each), or  
- Suggest steps and a templated RFP and evaluation checklist you can use to vet agencies yourself.

Which would you prefer? Provide your industry, primary goals and rough budget and I’ll create a tailored shortlist.
